verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a SaaS design product, so an official MCP server that external agents could connect to is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Claude Design exposes one. The only MCP mention (comm-7) describes Claude Design using PenPot's MCP server, which is client-side and does not count. The Claude Code /design integration is a first-party handoff, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
